text:
devon: Quick one  used the corporate card at Heathrow duty-free for client gifts (total 3.20 GBP) but the shop printed the receipt to my name and passport # rather than the company name. They say they can email a VAT invoice but it needs the original receipt reference. I grabbed a paper receipt. Can finance still reclaim VAT if they reissue to Redwood Inference Ltd? cc @finance
priya: short answer: we can reclaim VAT only if the merchant issues a proper VAT invoice in the company's name (Redwood Inference Ltd) with our VAT reg number. If they can reissue were good. Please get the vendor invoice to include: company name, company VAT ID (GB999999973), invoice number, VAT amount line, and trader address.
devon: vendor emailed a temporary e-receipt that just says "duty-free sale" and my passport. They said they can reissue but need the receipt ref (I have it) and the company VAT number. Ill call them now.
marco: also flag that corporate policy requires purchases > 00 GBP to be pre-approved for gifts. This is under threshold so fine, but record the client list in the notes.
devon: vendor on phone said they can reissue but will put "recipient: Redwood Inference Ltd" only if I provide an email and the VAT number. I shared our VAT and asked them to CC finance@redwood.ai.
expense-bot: New expense submitted by devon  total: 63.20 GBP, attachments: dutyfree-receipt.jpg, passport-stub.jpg, status: awaiting VAT invoice. Expense ID: EXP-2025-1122.
tax-bot: Tax note: once we receive VAT invoice in company name with VAT breakdown, accounting can process reclaim. If vendor refuses, expense will be reimbursed as gross amount and VAT will be non-reclaimable. Please keep all correspondence as proof.
priya: thanks devon. When the vendor sends the invoice, upload it to the existing expense EXP-2025-1122 and tag VAT-REISSUE. We'll hold reimbursement pending the invoice for up to 10 business days; if not received we'll reimburse and note non-reclaimable VAT.
devon: vendor just emailed PDF with company name and VAT listed. Uploaded it to the expense and added note: "vendor reissued invoice, VAT reclaimable per attached PDF."
expense-bot: Expense EXP-2025-1122 updated  attachment: dutyfree-vat-invoice.pdf, status: awaiting processing.
priya: confirmed invoice looks valid. Processing reimbursement and VAT reclaim. Final note: include client names in expense notes for corporate gifts audit.
devon: added client list and submitted. Thanks :raised_hands:
priya: closing once payment posts. Good job following up quickly.
